parsed.why: No criminalisation, but no recognition, no anti-discrimination or hate-crime recourse, non-functioning judiciary, documented hostility toward visible LGBTI people (2018), unresolved 2019 killing of an advocate, trans camp harassment. Dated advocacy bills unverified.

Decriminalised, constitutional gender-identity protection, state-backed trans programme with police/court cooperation, pride; police targeting of gender presentation is dated (2004) with no recent record. No facility ban documented, though enforcement is contested.

Colonial sodomy statutes (14/7/5 years) catch trans women read as male; no gender-identity protection or recourse; no prosecutions documented since 2013, thin data, a small gender-diverse tradition. Unenforced statute plus structural hostility extrapolates below the midpoint.

Trans gender identity and expression covered in enforceable hate-crime and hate-speech law, national dataset, working institutions; but a national pool chain bars self-chosen changing rooms, hate-speech prosecutions contested, organised political hostility. Pure positive offset by facility exposure.

Article 120 enforced 2009-2023; police arbitrarily detain, prosecute and imprison trans women and gay men; forced examinations amount to torture, extortion and coerced informing with impunity; constitution omits sexual orientation; no registration or recourse. State-directed targeting.
